title: Creamy Chicken and Zesty Broth
description: A comforting Dutch-inspired dish featuring chicken cooked in a zesty broth with a hint of almond creaminess.
instructions: 1. In a large pot, combine the chicken, zesty broth, and Dutch mustard.
2. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 15 minutes.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together the almond milk and almond butter until smooth.
4. Stir the almond milk mixture into the chicken and broth mixture.
5. Continue to simmer for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
7. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
8. Cook the chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
